xb9k30r0.sourceDescription: Create an extraordinary magical holiday ambience in your house with this swirl pre-lit Christmas tree! Swirl design: The artificial tree features a unique swirl design, making it an eye-catching centrepiece of your Christmas decorations.LED lights: The Xmas tree lights up beautifully and is decorated with multiple energy-efficient LED lights, creating a cosy holiday atmosphere.Different lighting effects: The LEDs are designed with 8 different lighting effects: a combination of all the effects, slow-glow, twinkle/flash, in wave, chasing/running water, sequential, steady on and slow fade.PVC tips: This Christmas decoration includes multiple PVC tips, which provide a stunningly realistic look to the tree and give it a very bushy appearance too.Stable pot: The bottom pot provides the Christmas tree with optimal stability. Note:The product has a USB connector, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

pq504ppx.variantName: Christmas Tree World 4ft Pre-Lit Cairngorm Pine Outdoor Potted Tree
pq504ppx.sourceDescription: Set the festive tone before guests enter your home with this elegant outdoor 4ft Christmas tree. Where to begin with the enchanting attributes of the Cairngorm Pine? First, there are the extremely realistic plastic-moulded branch tips which look stunning studded with warm white Christmas lights. Then, there is the traditional two-tone green far superior to the solid greens of many outdoor pre-lit Christmas trees. And let's not forget the attached hinged branches which make assembly so simple. Plus, we've thrown in some pretty plastic pinecones for good measure. It is Christmas, after all! nnypxmtp.baseName: COSTWAY 6 FT Snow-Flocked Half Christmas Tree With Lights-White
nnypxmtp.variantName: COSTWAY 6 FT Snow-Flocked Half Christmas Tree With Lights-White
nnypxmtp.sourceDescription: This snow-flocked Xmas tree adopts realistic PE needles and non-deformable PVC leaves, forming dense layered boughs with 610/860 branch tips to restore the vivid look of a snow-covered natural fir. Equipped with vibrant 180/240 LED lights that support both warm white and multi-color illumination, it offers 11 lighting effects to suit various settings and modes, including combination, C1 steady on, C2 steady on, C1 mixture, C2 mixture, slo-glo, breathing, C1 slo-glo, C2 slo-glo, flash and in wave. Paired with a light controller and a UL certified adapter, it brings stable, safe and adjustable festive radiance. Built with 100% new PE and PVC materials, the tree is flame-retardant, fade-resistant, smell-less and allergy-proof. Moreover, its 3-section hinged structure and sturdy folding metal stand enable effortless installation and tidy storage, while the gloves included further simplify foliage arrangement for a hassle-free holiday experience. Note: Ornaments are not included. Unique Half Design: This corner Xmas tree boasts a flat-back half profile that nestles seamlessly against walls and tight corners. Its compact silhouette, which frees up precious floor space, unlocks lush festive beauty even for the coziest, space-limited nooks. Snow-Kissed & Full Balsam Fir: Dressed in dreamy snowy flocking, this half-shaped balsam fir tree holds 610 dense branch tips. Crafted with blended PE and PVC foliage, its rich overlapping boughs create a luxuriant full shape, capturing the lush charm of a snow-dusted evergreen. Dual-Tone Holiday Radiance: This snow-flocked Xmas tree boasts 180 dual-color LEDs (warm white and multi-color) with 11 lighting modes to craft your perfect festive glow. Meanwhile, the light controller ensures easy operation and the UL certified adapter provides consistent, safe power supply. Reliable Materials: Crafted from 100% new PE and PVC foliage, this lighted Christmas tree has flame-retardant, fade-resistant, allergy-proof and smell-free properties. It stays brilliantly vibrant season after season, letting you enjoy joyful holiday moments with total peace of mind. Easy Assembly: Split into 3 simple sections, this flocked Xmas tree features hinged branches that unfurl smoothly into a natural silhouette. Its robust folding metal stand clicks securely into place, and protective assembly gloves come included. Ditch lengthy assembly work and immerse yourself in cozy holiday moments. Specifications Color: White Material: PE, PVC, Metal Product Dimensions: 53 x 180 cm (W x H) Tree Height: 6 ft/180 cm Half Tree Width: 1.7 ft/53 cm Diameter of Stand: 18"/45 cm Number of Branch Tips: 610 Number of LED Lights: 180 Number of Sections: 3 Power Cord Length: 150 cm Net Weight: 6 kg Is Assembly Required: Yes Box Qty: 1(May vary by batch) Package Includes： 1 x Christmas Tree 1 x Pair of Gloves 1 x User Guide Retain instructions for future reference.always place the product on a flat, steady and stable surface.keep all small parts and packaging materials for this product away from babies and children as they potentially pose a serious choking hazard. FDS CORPORATION LIMITED Unit 4, Blackacre Road, Great Blakenham, Ipswich, United Kingdom, IP6 0FL

hfn0n8pq.sourceDescription: One of our best-selling 12ft Christmas trees, the Woodland Pine has a "freshly cut" look. And of course there are the strong, hinged branches that make this tall Xmas tree easy to put up and bring down. Picture shows 7ft tree in the range. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase.
